provenance.note: Actual OpenCV detections of synthetic images; not the website center-only DOB implementation.

settings.geometry_note: Known frontoparallel square; truth corners are warp vertices before area downsampling. Rasterization and corner refinement can introduce a small localization offset.

selection.rule: First frame at or after 1 s with relative rigid LS residual >= 0.03; otherwise maximum settled residual.

residual_definition: Euclidean norm of the 8D least-squares residual against the full 8x6 rigid-object twist Jacobian, divided by estimated 8D flow norm; true geometry and fixed camera.
limitations: Synthetic rendering, not measured sensor noise or a captured robot event.
Nonzero exact compatibility residual is expected with noisy estimates; no statistical significance or failure rate is asserted.
